chunks: And Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
"The bathhouse, every other day, does not increase flesh; and making a habit of it every day removes the fat of the two kidneys."
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about using the bathhouse every day?
ai.summary: Imam Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام gives guidance on moderation in using the bathhouse. He states that visiting it every other day is acceptable, while excessive daily use has harmful bodily effects.
